plugins.name: CAD
plugins.description: Design 3D parts and assemblies by writing short scripts, and see them drawn as solid models you can orbit in a four-view editor. Your AI agent can build and edit designs with you and check them: measure holes and clearances, find collisions and fastener problems, and test that a part can slide in or out. Import STL or glTF meshes as references, and export your design as STEP, STL, 3MF, or glTF files. Models are saved in .mcad files. The plugin brings its own Python geometry engine, so there is nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Code Tools
plugins.description: Code-understanding tools for your AI agent and a code-graph panel for you. It indexes a repository's files and symbols, then lets you search them, see what calls what, spot dead code and duplication, and review git diffs side by side. It also gives the agent file read, write, edit, search, and shell tools. It brings its own Python runtime, so there is nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Council
plugins.description: Ask a question from an ordinary Minerva chat and get an answer from a small council: a chair plus a few advisors, some of them grounded in your own notes. The chat shows the chair's summary, and the Council editor shows each member's full argument with its sources. You need at least one AI model provider set up in Minerva. This version runs on Linux x86_64 only.

plugins.name: Drive
plugins.description: Keep a folder of files in sync across all your computers (Windows, macOS, and Linux). Every save uploads a new version to the cloud, so older versions stay recoverable, and when two machines edit the same file, the other edit is kept beside it as a conflict copy instead of being lost. You can also download a cloud-only project to any machine. You need to be signed in to a Minerva account.

plugins.name: 3D Generator
plugins.description: Turn a text prompt or a reference image into a 3D model. Results are saved as GLB files you can reopen from a .m3d document, and your AI agent can generate models with the same tools. Generation runs on Minerva's media service, so you need to be signed in to a Minerva account; nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Movie Generator
plugins.description: Generate short videos (MP4) from a text prompt, from a single starting image, or by filling in the motion between a first and a last frame. Your AI agent can generate clips with the same tools, and projects are saved in .mmovie documents. Generation runs on Minerva's media service, so you need to be signed in to a Minerva account; nothing else to install.

plugins.name: MultiMeter
plugins.description: Read an OWON B41T+ Bluetooth digital multimeter live inside Minerva. Your AI agent can read the current measurement, watch trends, press the meter's buttons, and record readings to CSV; the panel shows the live value with a rolling graph. Needs the meter powered on with its Bluetooth enabled and a Bluetooth radio on this computer; nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Oscilloscope
plugins.description: See and measure two-channel waveforms from a Hantek 6022BE USB oscilloscope inside Minerva. People and AI agents share capture controls, probe settings, measurements and saved data. Requires the scope and USB access; firmware and native dependencies are included.

plugins.name: PCB Editor
plugins.description: Design printed circuit boards in Minerva. Place and route components, manage nets and copper layers, and check your design. When the board is ready, export a manufacturing order package in JLCPCB's format or a 3D model of the assembled board. Your AI agent can read and edit the board with you. Adding official KiCad parts and fetching vendor 3D models needs an internet connection; nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Presentation
plugins.description: Build slide decks in Minerva. Each slide holds text, image, and spreadsheet tiles that you can arrange and annotate, and decks are saved as .mdeck documents inside your project. Your AI agent can read and edit open decks with you. Nothing else to install.

plugins.name: Scansort
plugins.description: Sort scanned documents into encrypted, password-protected vaults. Scansort extracts each document's text, uses an AI model and rules you write to decide where it belongs, and files it, so you can search and pull documents back out later. You need at least one AI model provider set up in Minerva for classification.
